ideas.name: any warning on a narrow bar
ideas.why: a warning on a bar under half the 1m ATR is momentum fading on its own, not a shock bar that a fast market can reverse straight back

ideas.name: any warning with the 1m rows split
ideas.why: with the EMA row one side and the MACD row the other, the trend is already contested, so a warning has less to turn

ideas.name: any warning the way yesterday closed strong
ideas.why: a close in the top (bottom) fifth of yesterday's range shows buyers (sellers) holding into the bell; that pressure carries into today, so turns its way pay

ideas.name: any warning after a heavy overnight
ideas.why: overnight volume over 1.3x its 20-day norm means news or repositioning: RTH tends to trend on it, so turns fail
